0022600228.text: The Detroit Pistons (7-3, 1st in the Central, 3rd in the East, riding a one-game win streak) visit the Washington Wizards (4-8, 5th in the Southeast and 3 games back, 12th in the East, on a five-game losing streak) for the Pistons' 11th game of the season. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Ugonna Onyenso (foot) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), Reece Beekman (out, shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve). Detroit leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and the Pistons also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
